lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₂Si₆O₁₆ (reduced formula VSi₃O₈) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral V centers coordinated by four O neighbors and octahedral Si centers coordinated by six O neighbors, alongside six-coordinate O environments. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between V tetrahedra and Si octahedra and between Si octahedra, and Si octahedra also show edge-sharing.
